## Track & Responsibility
- [ ] **Track 1**: Platform & Infrastructure (SDE 1)
- [ ] **Track 2**: Core Engine & Domain Logic (SDE 2)
- [ ] **Track 3**: Web Client & UI/UX (SDE 3)
- [ ] **Track 4**: Quality, Observability & Data (SDE 4)

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: A new feature
- [ ] `fix`: A bug fix
- [ ] `refactor`: Code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `contract`: Modification to `packages/contracts` (Requires cross-track signoff)
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, configuration, or CI pipeline update

## Quality Checklist
- [ ] I have executed `npm run ci` locally and all checks passed.
- [ ] All new logic is covered by unit or integration tests.
- [ ] Any modified API contracts in `packages/contracts` have been communicated to frontend/backend tracks.
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` variables, or sensitive data committed.
- [ ] Code follows project style guidelines (Ruff / Prettier / Pyright).
